correctness.rationale: Direct integral proof: the full one-skeleton has rank-28 cycle lattice; all missing triangle boundaries have explicit tetrahedral fillings, so H1=0 and H2 has ranks 47 and 48. An explicit tetrahedral boundary gives the coefficient-one quotient map. Exhaustive 12-automorphism enumeration plus complete signed orbit-action check yields eight primitive twisted orbit generators. Four actual boundary-edge equations imply x7=-6(x1+x3+x6); the integral vector (1,-2,0,0,-2,0,1,6) has zero boundary on all 36 edges, proving exact lifting index six. The rational character follows from reduced Lefschetz traces on all 12 elements and exact irreducible inner products. Executed verification artifact verifies every finite premise.
